v4l  is an __xservername__ driver for video4linux cards. It provides a Xvideo
extension port for video overlay. Just add the driver to the module list
within the module section of your __xconfigfile__ file if you want to use it.
There are no config options.

 Note that the the extmod module is also required for the Xvideo support
 (and lots of other extensions too).
xf86-video-v4l: move if from crater to the drivers directory.
